analogy.rationale: MMP inhibitors block secreted/extracellular proteases whose substrates (matrix, cytokines) are largely post-transcriptional, so transcriptional responses are minimal; the closest reference class is the broader metalloproteinase inhibitor, with angiogenesis/anti-inflammatory/anticancer classes overlapping in indication but not mechanism.
